title: 여신전문금융업법 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:01635:20200805:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Appendix (Rules for the Enforcement of the Act on the Use and Protection of Credit Information) <No. 1635, August 5, 2020>

Article 1 (Effective Date) This rule shall take effect from August 5, 2020.

Article 2 (Amendments to Other Regulations) ① Omitted

  ② The following amendments shall be made to part of the Rules for the Enforcement of the Act on Specialized Financial Institutions:

  Item 1 of Article 3, paragraph 1, sub-item a, shall be changed from "credit rating and overdue period of credit card members or direct charge card members" to "credit rating and personal credit score of credit card members or direct charge card members, and overdue period", and sub-item b of the same item shall be changed from "credit rating" to "credit rating or personal credit score".
